title: Sign-in & security
sub: Two-step sign-in, how long a login lasts, the wrong-password pause, new-device alerts, the admin address list and the shop's quiet protections.
advice2fa: Two-step sign-in is not required yet. Turning it on is the strongest single protection for the admin: a stolen password alone is then not enough.

signIn.d: How staff sign in and how long a login lasts.
signIn.twoFactorHelp: After the password, a 6-digit code from an app on the phone. A person without it sets it up at the next sign-in.
signIn.idleMinutes: Log out after this many idle minutes
signIn.maxHours: Log out after this many hours in total
signIn.lockoutMinutes: Pause after too many wrong passwords (minutes)
signIn.loginAlerts: Note every staff sign-in, and alert on a new device
signIn.loginAlertsHelp: A sign-in from a phone or computer not seen before shows in the notifications of everyone who sees security, and goes to Telegram once the bot is connected.
signIn.noteDays: Keep new-device sign-ins in the notifications (days)

allowlist.d: Off by default. When on, the admin opens only from these internet addresses.
allowlist.enabled: Open the admin only from the addresses below
allowlist.entries: Addresses (one a line; a range such as 203.0.113.0/24 is fine)
allowlist.youOff: It is not on the list.
allowlist.unknown: The address you are on cannot be read here.
allowlist.warn: If your internet address changes (a new router, mobile data), you cannot open the admin until someone on the list or the server takes the list off.
allowlist.breakGlass: The server has the list switched off right now (EXTAS_ADMIN_ALLOWLIST_OFF). It applies again when that is removed.

protection.d: Quiet protections the customer never sees. Each starts in a safe mode that only watches.
protection.csp: Page protection (what a page may load)
protection.cspHelp: Report only writes down what would be stopped; On makes the browser stop it. Turn on after a week without reports.
protection.rateHelp: Observe only writes a log line when an address sends too much; On asks it to wait a minute. Many phones share one mobile address, so the limits are generous.
protection.bot: Quiet bot check on sign-in and checkout
protection.botHelp: Writes a note in the security list below when a form looks filled by a program. It never stops an order or a sign-in.

moreSub: The numbers behind the request limits and the bot check.

limits.h: Requests a minute for one address
limits.d: Used only when request limits are on or observing.

bot.d: A form sent faster than these seconds counts as a sign of a program (0 = no time check).
bot.checkoutSeconds: Checkout: fastest a person fills it (seconds)
bot.noteScore: Write a note from this score (1–100)

devices.d: The phones and computers where you are logged in now.
devices.confirmText: Every other phone and computer where you are logged in must sign in again.
devices.error: That did not work. Please try again.

events.d: Sign-ins from a new device, wrong-password pauses and bot notes, the newest first.

kind.staff_login_newDevice: Staff sign-in from a new device
kind.staff_2fa_reset: Two-step sign-in reset by the owner

readOnly: You can see these settings; changing them needs the security permission.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this card; it shows their values now.
err.ADDRESS_NOT_ON_LIST: The list must hold the address you are saving from ({fields}), or you would lock yourself out.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this.
err.unauthorized: Your sign-in has ended — please sign in again.
err.other: That did not save. Please try again.
